# custom-image-viewer
Element UI `el-dialog`-based image preview component used in the zhi2-web-admin project.

## Description
- Referenced only inside the `ImageViewer` component; not mounted as a global overlay.
- Provides image preview with an X close button and a thumbnail-triggered open path.

## Architecture
- `openPreview` store action is the only trigger, dispatched exclusively by clicking thumbnails.
- Close behavior is driven by the preview store plus a `:visible.sync` computed property.
- Element UI is loaded externally from `public/assets`, not from node_modules.

## Open Concern
- Unverified risk that the drag directive on the dialog may swallow the X close-button click.
- Store and computed close logic is sound on paper; actual Element UI close path not yet confirmed.

# custom-image-viewer
Element UI `el-dialog`-based image preview component used in the zhi2-web-admin project.

## Description
- Referenced only inside the `ImageViewer` component; not mounted as a global overlay.
- Provides image preview with an X close button and a thumbnail-triggered open path.

## Architecture
- `openPreview` store action is the only trigger, dispatched exclusively by clicking thumbnails.
- Close behavior is driven by the preview store plus a `:visible.sync` computed property.
- Element UI is loaded externally from `public/assets`, not from node_modules.

## Open Concern
- Drag directive alone ruled out as cause: `zs-dialog` uses the same `v-dialogDrag` directive and closes fine, so the directive by itself does not swallow the X close-button click.
- The `:visible.sync` computed + `v-if` close path is confirmed logically sound; remaining unknown is Element UI's actual close flow (need to inspect compiled `el-dialog` source to see what the X button does and where a header-level `mousedown` could swallow the close).
